displayName: Obfuscated Files or Information: SVG Smuggling

tests.name: T1027.017 - Inline JavaScript via Embedded SVG Script Element
tests.description: Constructs a standard SVG graphic containing an embedded inline <script> element.

tests.name: T1027.017 - Base64 Blob Payload Assembly via SVG JavaScript
tests.description: Embeds a Base64-encoded string inside an SVG script that creates a binary Blob download.

tests.name: T1027.017 - XML CDATA Section Script Obfuscation
tests.description: Encapsulates executable JavaScript logic inside an XML CDATA section.

tests.name: T1027.017 - Root SVG Event Handler Execution (`onload`)
tests.description: Utilizes onload attributes directly on the root SVG element.

tests.name: T1027.017 - Nested HTML via SVG `<foreignObject>` Smuggling
tests.description: Leverages the SVG foreignObject tag to embed HTML5 elements and scripts.

tests.name: T1027.017 - SVG Animation Element Script Execution (`<animate>`)
tests.description: Uses SVG SMIL animation elements with event handlers like onbegin.

tests.name: T1027.017 - XLink / Data URI Script Smuggling in SVG
tests.description: Uses the xlink:href attribute combined with a data URI script.

tests.name: T1027.017 - SVG Custom Data Attribute Payload Staging (`data-*`)
tests.description: Stores obfuscated payload strings inside custom data-* attributes.

tests.name: T1027.017 - Dynamic DOM Element Construction via SVG JavaScript
tests.description: Constructs hidden HTML elements dynamically using JavaScript DOM manipulation.

tests.name: T1027.017 - Shadow DOM / Web Component SVG Payload Encapsulation
tests.description: Hides executable JavaScript within a Shadow DOM root attached to a custom component.
